How to calculate cost per hire in SHRM?
What is the average cost per hire in the US?

Defines cost per hire (CPH) as the average spend to recruit a new employee ($4,500-$4,800 typical range), gives the formula (Internal Costs + External Costs / Total Hires), groups costs into Internal Costs (prorated recruiter/HR salaries, referral awards, hiring-manager interview time) and External Costs (job board fees, agency/search firm fees, ATS costs, background checks, travel/relocation), notes variance by company size/industry/role seniority (specialized technical or C-suite roles: $15,000-$30,000+), and closes on tracking quarterly against the SHRM Cost-Per-Hire Standard.
